company.shortDescription: Readily provides an AI-powered compliance platform for healthcare organizations and health plans.
company.description: Readily provides an AI-powered compliance platform for healthcare organizations and health plans. The platform centralizes internal policies, procedures, contracts, and external regulations into a unified, version-controlled knowledge base. It uses artificial intelligence to search, interpret, and connect regulatory requirements with internal documents, helping teams quickly find relevant clauses and answers. Readily tracks new regulations, analyzes their impact across departments and policies, and surfaces gaps and action items. It also assists with preparing responses and supporting documentation for audits, reducing manual review and back-and-forth with regulators. The software is designed for compliance officers, regulatory affairs teams, and business units in highly regulated healthcare environments who need to manage complex, evolving rules efficiently.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven compliance platform that centralizes healthcare policies and regulations to automate research, gap analysis, and audit preparation.
